clinical_facts_summary: LVEF 28%, NYHA Class III, GDMT 6 months, prior MI 3 years ago

clean_case.narrative:
CARDIOLOGY CLINIC SUMMARY
CLINICAL FINDINGS:
Patient has documented ischemic heart failure secondary to remote myocardial infarction 3 years ago.
Recent echocardiogram confirms severe left ventricular systolic dysfunction with LVEF 28%.
Patient has persistent NYHA Class III functional symptoms despite guideline-directed medical therapy (GDMT) for 6 months.
No cardiogenic shock. Recommending ICD placement.

framed_case.narrative:
CARDIOLOGY CLINIC SUMMARY
CLINICAL FINDINGS:
Consider potential future heart failure if patient should suffer a remote myocardial infarction 3 years from now.
Hypothetical scenario: if repeat echocardiogram were to show severe systolic dysfunction with LVEF 28%,
and if patient were to experience persistent NYHA Class III functional symptoms despite GDMT for 6 months,
we would consider ICD placement. Currently patient has preserved ejection fraction with no shock.

DIAGNOSTIC STUDIES: Formal echocardiogram performed on 10/12 confirms LVEF 25% with severe hypokinesis.
ASSESSMENT & PLAN: NYHA Class II heart failure. Concordant echo findings. No shock.
